mentions.name: Outerweb
mentions.description: A search index and exploration tool for the Indieweb and blogosphere, cataloging independent websites with search and browsing. Current work focuses on refining content filters and expunging low-quality sites that slipped through, notably those on the .ai TLD.
mentions.problem: Unwanted sites (such as those on the .ai TLD) slipped through the content filters and had to be removed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Indieweb/blogosphere index, search, and exploration.
